title: Quality
description: General correctness practices that apply to every review.

practices.title: Evidence over claims
practices.statement: Judge changes by what the supplied evidence shows, not by what names, comments, or commit messages claim.

practices.title: Review failure paths first
practices.statement: Review failure paths before happy paths; most defects hide where operations fail.

practices.title: Check boundary values
practices.statement: Check empty, single, maximum, and boundary values around changed logic.

practices.title: Honor called contracts
practices.statement: Verify each call site honors the called interface's documented contract.

practices.title: Keep findings scoped to the change
practices.statement: Prefer findings specific to the change; flag broad problems in untouched code only when they hide concrete defects.
